Key Research Thinking Patterns: Pattern Name: High-Resolution Imaging via Fourier Ptychography Microscopy (FPM) (Utilizing FPM to achieve high-resolution chromosome imaging with lower equivalent NA and efficient slide scanning for chromosome karyotyping)
Pattern Name: Semi-Supervised Learning for Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) (Developing VAT-based models for mammographic breast mass classification using semi-supervised learning and unlabeled data)

Pattern Name: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis (Applying deep learning techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks and Transformers for medical image analysis and computer-aided diagnosis)
Pattern Name: Image Processing and Enhancement (Employing image processing filters and techniques such as Gaussian Bandpass Filtering and Phase Retrieval Algorithm for image enhancement and analysis)
Summary Description: Dr. Liu Hong is a researcher specializing in biomedical engineering and electrical engineering, with a focus on medical imaging, computer-aided diagnosis, and machine learning. Her work involves developing novel computer-aided detection schemes for breast cancer screening and diagnosis, as well as high-resolution imaging techniques for chromosome analysis. She employs a range of methods, including Fourier Ptychography Microscopy, semi-supervised learning, and deep learning, to improve image quality and accuracy. Her research has the potential to enhance early cancer detection, risk prediction, and medical imaging capabilities.
